summary:
# Austin City Hall Construction Dispute

• **City Hall nearing completion**: The council reviewed progress on Austin's new City Hall building and approved a $4,331.75 payment to contractors for completed work, with only the stairway and vestibule remaining unfinished.

• **Heated debate among aldermen**: Committee members disagreed sharply on how to handle the incomplete staircase work, forcing the council to adjourn and reconvene the next day to reach a compromise.

• **Contractor deadline set**: The council gave contractors Belger & Bryson 45 days (until late February 1908) to complete the stairway and vestibule, or the city would hire someone else to finish the work at the contractor's expense.

• **Withheld payment as leverage**: The city retained $1,500 from the final payment—roughly one-third of the outstanding balance—to ensure the contractors completed their remaining obligations according to original specifications.

Austin, Texas, Jan 9 1908.
To the Honorable City Council of the City of Austin. Gentlemen: We have carefully
considered the matter of the partial acceptance of the the City Hall and would make the
following suggestion, subject to your approval: We would suggest that such contract as the
City has with Messrs Belger & Brydson be left in its present form, and that the City
accept the building under the present contract from Messrs Belger & Brydson, except the
stairway and stair vestibule, which is not yet completed; that the City retain from the
contract price the sum of $ 1500.00, which said sum of $ 1500.00 shall be paid to Messrs
Belger & Brydson upon the completion of the stairway and stair vestibule, according to the
plans and specifications heretofore adopted and agreed upon covering that portion of the
contract. We recommend that 45 days from this date ,namely, Jan. 9, 1908, be given Messrs
Belger & Brydson in which to complete the stairway and stair vestibule, according to the
plans and specifications heretofore adopted covering the stairs and stair vestibule, and
that, in the event such stairway and stair vestibule be not completed according to the
plans and specifications within said 45 days, the City of Austin be authorized to have
same completed
